# Let me analyze this ARC task grid
grid = [
    [1, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 5, 6],
    [7, 3, 6, 7, 3, 6, 5, 6],
    [6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 5, 1],
    [6, 4, 6, 5, 6, 6, 6, 6],
    [3, 4, 6, 4, 7, 1, 5, 6],
    [6, 5, 6, 3, 6, 6, 6, 5],
    [4, 3, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6],
    [6, 4, 6, 4, 6, 5, 1, 1]
]

# Count colors
from collections import Counter
all_cells = [cell for row in grid for cell in row]
color_counts = Counter(all_cells)
print("Color counts:", dict(color_counts))

# Analyze patterns - look at column 6 specifically (has many 5s)
print("\nColumn 6 values:", [grid[r][6] for r in range(8)])

# Look for 6s (background)
print("\nGrid of 6s (background positions):")
for r in range(8):
    row_str = ""
    for c in range(8):
        if grid[r][c] == 6:
            row_str += "6 "
        else:
            row_str += ". "
    print(row_str)
